name: Hong Kong Countryside Conservation Funding Scheme

funder.name: Countryside Conservation Office, Environment and Ecology Bureau (Hong Kong)

summary: Hong Kong government funding for local non-profits to run countryside conservation projects, including management agreements that improve ecological value of privately owned sites. Rounds invite projects for set themes and locations.
reporting: Inception report within one month of start, half-yearly progress reports with statements of account, annual audited accounts, and a completion report with final audited account.

status.quote: The cut-off time of application for this round of application is 5 p.m. on 13 August 2026 (Thursday).

deadline.quote: The cut-off time of application for this round of application is 5 p.m. on 13 August 2026 (Thursday).

applicant_types.quote: provide financial support to local non-profit-making organisations (NPOs) and villagers for organising diverse and innovative conservation activities or projects in the countryside (except Lantau Island)

geography.quote: conservation activities or projects in the countryside (except Lantau Island)

access.quote: Local NPOs which want to apply for funding support under the CCFS to implement any of the above types of projects in eligible sites can submit the completed Application Form

window.quote: is inviting a new round of applications for the following types of projects under prescribed themes, locations and scopes specified below

reporting.quote: the applicant shall, within one month after the commencement of the project, submit an inception report to the Secretariat.
